mod.vein_farming.name: Vein Farming: Universal Crop Harvester
mod.vein_farming.description: Universal AOE farming for Standalone mode, LiteMiner, or FTB Ultimine. Area Tilling, Smart Mass Planting, and AOE Bone Meal fertilizing.
config.vein_farming.pull_from_inventory: Pull Seeds & Bone Meal from Inventory
advancements.vein_farming.root.title: It Ain't Much, But It's Honest Work
advancements.vein_farming.root.descripti: Perform your first mass farming action with Vein Farming.
Duplicate a small flower with Bone Meal... wait, since when can we do this in Java?!
advancements.vein_farming.civil_engineer: Irrigate a field by holding a Hoe and Water Bucket, automatically digging 8-block spaced water wells.
advancements.vein_farming.crop_rotation_: Plant alternating parallel rows of crops by holding different seeds in each hand for 200% growth speed.
advancements.vein_farming.the_lorax_appr: Plant a spacious sapling orchard or a 2x2 mega tree grove using smart spacing.
advancements.vein_farming.speedrun_compo: Shift-click a Composter with seeds or compostables to convert entire stacks into Bone Meal instantly.
advancements.vein_farming.living_on_the_: Have your farming tool saved from breaking at exactly 1 durability.
advancements.vein_farming.lazy_farmer_30: Harvest 64 or more mature crops in a single instant click.
